note: National plant-identification plates for GoettschePreppy. Every image is a real photograph or a published botanical line drawing from a US Government source (USDA NRCS PLANTS, USDA Forest Service, USDA ARS); no AI-generated imagery is ever acceptable for identification. Each image was looked at before selection: the "shows" text describes what is actually in the frame, and images with a copyright notice in the frame were refused even when the source record says public domain. Plates help you recognise danger; they do not make a photograph an identification for eating.
